title: Create Lite
description: A collection of some of my favourite Create Add-ons, created esspecially with old computers in mind. If your computer runs slow and has problem with most of other modpacks, this one is for you.
body:
## Create Lite 
**If your computer runs slower than a potato than this modpack was created for you!**  

Create Lite is a Trully lightweighted modpack made with older and weaker computers in mind.
It can run pretty smoothly even with just 2-4GB Ram Memory Allocated.


The Modpack contains Create mod with a number of add-ons to make it feel whole. Mods like Farmer's Delight Ammendents and YUNG's Better Structures makes for a great Vanilla + Experience. 

Beside the whole Create automations you should expect new improved structures, better food and lots of quality of life but still fairplay additions like Jetpacks!
